checked.claim: Keep speaking, the X and Escape close Your turn for the rest of the turn, so Done and Pass cannot be reached again.
checked.why: promptTurn sets promptedFor to the turn's key before drawing; any answer other than done, pass or thesis returns at :217 without resetting it, and the once-a-second tick calls promptTurn, which returns at :175 for the same key. promptedFor is put back only on the thesis road (:214). git grep requestTurn: the only Done/Pass sender is this window (trial-prompt.mjs:220); hud.mjs and the voice tile draw no Done or Pass. The window's body and both handbooks (player-handbook.en.md:894, 896) tell the speaker to press Done. The E70 fix p2-G3 note (:194-197) chose Keep speaking as the default so Enter ends nothing; it does not say the window stays closed. The verdict 'mislabeled' is a loose fit (the label is honest, the window's promise is not kept), but the failure scenario holds.
evidence: lang/en.json DRPG.Trial.turn.body: "{mode}: you have the floor. Press Done when you finish, or Pass to give up your turn."

checked.claim: The participants' clock does not start on the floor's first write in a world, because only updateSetting is heard, not createSetting.

What was not confirmed: that Foundry v14 fires createSetting and not updateSetting on a world setting's first write is read from the module's own notes (gm-store.mjs:1750-1752), not from Foundry or a recorded reading. The window is also narrow: it is the floor's first write in the world's whole life, and the console's default first step is Open the debate (trial-floor-ui.mjs:1416), whose write would create the document before any round or Closing; a season reset writes the floor empty (trial.mjs:767).
